CAND.base_composition: state + dynamics draw after the T2 simplex map, then production noise transfer
CAND.c_T_in_T4: each draw's mapped base composition, REST included, floored at 1.0 pp
CAND.noise: T3-rev selection, refitted per T4 target on elections strictly before it
CAND.state_and_dynamics: T2 selection; a U arm replaces OpinionState with the filter posterior x k; D0 retained otherwise

D0.dynamics: production symmetric CLR bootstrap, eval horizon min(h,112), fallback 28/14/7 when < 30 transitions
D0.state: OpinionState v1.1 (estimate_opinion) with the v0.3 timeseries file setting the mean, the residual covariance and the transitions; production polls file

Ua.dynamics: process x days x multinomial_shape(s) + house_drift x days x sum (w_h/sum w)^2 x reference_shape (consensus_reading_at increment), plus election-day shocks
Ua.election_shock_parameters: origin segment s_shock and h_reset; s = latent mean at origin; origin reference_shape
Ua.election_shocks: for each election day in the open interval (origin, D): s_shock x multinomial_shape(s) + h_reset x sum (w_h/sum w)^2 x reference_shape; none for an election on D itself
Ua.state: consensus_reading_at(state, origin, w) covariance x k^2

Ub1.dynamics_variance: (sigma2/theta)(1 - exp(-theta days)) x full multinomial_shape(s) matrix; sigma2 = origin segment process
Ub1.note: variance <= Ua's random-walk variance; saturating alternative by design

Ub2.mean: A + (x - A) exp(-theta days); A = eight named shares of the last election available on or before the origin

Uc.combination: state draw mapped by the simplex map -> CLR -> add delta -> composition
Uc.dynamics: symmetric CLR bootstrap of v0.3 transitions at h exactly, no cap
Uc.fallback: fewer than 30 eligible transitions at h: largest h' < h on the grid with >= 30, deltas scaled by sqrt(h/h')

common_poll_term.Omega: sample covariance (8x8, pp) of target-style window average at c (3-poll minimum) minus v0.3 causal reading at c
common_poll_term.centres: expanding window over a DAILY grid: every calendar day c from 2010-09-26 with c + 7 <= origin meeting the 3-poll minimum; polls published on or before the origin; overlapping windows make neighbours correlated, Omega is a covariance estimate only
common_poll_term.law: N(0, Omega_origin), identical draws for every arm, added after the simplex map, not clipped

gates.T2-G3: coverage_90 in [0.80, 0.97] for the medium group and for the long group

k.D_pp: max(0, Var_p(k = 1 predictive draws) - S_pp - Omega_pp)
k.Omega_pp: poll-average variance at the past origin
k.S_pp: state variance (pp^2) at the past origin
k.e_p: target - mean of the arm's k = 1 predictive draws
k.eligible: past (origin', h in {7, 28}) targets with D' + 7 <= origin and every window poll published on or before the origin
k.equation: mean over eligible past targets of (1/8) sum_p e_p^2 / (k^2 S_pp + D_pp + Omega_pp) = 1
k.solve: 1-D root-finding on k in [0.5, 3]; no root -> nearer bound

metrics.primary: CRPS per party (pp) from draws, scripts/pollofpolls/backtest_metrics.py::calculate_crps, averaged over 8 parties per (origin, h)

origins.condition: v0.3 reading exists; data available at the origin only
origins.first_scored_origin: first grid date at which every T2 arm, Omega (>= 30 centres) and theta (>= 3 variogram lags with pairs) are all defined; same for all arms; recorded; earlier dates unscored

reported_only: block bootstrap by election cycle of long-group CRPS difference vs D0

seeds.D0: production sub-seed functions with the case seed as base_seed; Z_poll from the shared generator
seeds.draw_order: one default_rng draws Z_state, Z_dyn, Z_poll (4000x8 each), then Uc bootstrap indices and signs

selection.rule: lowest long-group CRPS among passing arms; a simpler passing arm within 2% is preferred

applies_to.CAND_T4: base composition before production noise transfer

steps: complete with REST = 100 - sum of eight
clip each of nine categories at 0.01 pp

target.polls: load_polls observations with fieldwork midpoint in [D-7, D+7]
target.value: effective-sample-weighted mean of raw eight named-party shares (pp)

theta.fit: least squares on log scale: sum over lags of (log gamma_hat - log model)^2
theta.model: (sigma2/theta)(1 - exp(-theta h)), sigma2 = filter process variance
theta.pairs: expanding: all pairs with later date <= origin
theta.variogram: uncentred (x_{t+h,p} - x_{t,p})^2 / multinomial_shape(x_t)[p,p], averaged over parties and pairs per lag

T2.vague_prior_anchor: reduces to Ub1 in the mean; not a separate arm

N0.law: interim law, calibration amendment 001: gaussian, beta 0.5, gamma 0, Sigma = fit_election_noise_b on the centred pool

T3rev.final_refit: selected law on all seven corrected residuals 2002-2026
T3rev.forecast: corrected consensus + r via apply_batch_simplex_transfer(eps=0.01 pp)

gates.T3r-G2: each rolling target ES <= 1.10 x N0

T3rev.mc_fragility: a gate outcome differing across the five seeds is failed

metrics.brier_threshold: mean over eight parties of (P(share >= 4) - 1[actual >= 4])^2 from draws (protocol v4 section 6)

T3rev.residuals: corrected (residual amendments 001 and 002), nine categories, zero-sum cleaned
T3rev.seed: int(sha256('calibration-2030:T3rev:<year>:<rolling|loo|heldout>')[:8], 16); one default_rng draws Z (20000x9), shared by all arms; extra seeds append ':1'..':4'

selection.rule: lowest rolling mean ES among passing arms; a simpler passing arm within 1% is preferred

size_scaling.categories: all nine; REST scaled like the parties with its own consensus share
size_scaling.map: r = u_tilde * c_T^gamma, c_T the target's corrected consensus floored at 1.0 pp
size_scaling.standardize: u_e = r_e / c_e^gamma with c_e the residual's own election consensus

unreported_category.disclosure: NH0 differs from N0 in this cell as well as in the hierarchical law
unreported_category.rule: a category no contributing poll reported in the election's consensus is set to u = 0 before projection, in every NH arm (gamma 0, 0.5, 1)

arms.F1: C0 + corrected residuals; reported, not gated

T4.g7_calibration_clause: applies if CAND dynamics differ from D0
T4.gates: parent section 4.4 G1-G7 and 2026 flag, unchanged (data/processed/calibration_2030/preregistration.json T4.gates)

runtime.candidate_path: new modules under scripts/calibration_2030/ or diagnostics/calibration_2030/; hashed production files unmodified
runtime.self_check: configured as C0, reproduces C0 bytes

substitutions_2010: v0.3 rows 2007-01-01..2010-09-25 from the SH filter in causal mode with HYPERPARAMETER_START plus SH new-parameter starts (s_shock 3.162e-4, h_reset 1e-5), rolling weights; every 2010 case origin >= 2007-09-20

v0.2 rows 2007-01-01..2010-09-25 for C0 and F1: v0.2 filter (no SH injection) in causal mode with HYPERPARAMETER_START, DAILY ROLLING weights (frozen-per-segment weights cannot be formed before the first fit date; declared difference, reported-only rows); FB uses the v0.3 substitution
noise pool K = 2 (2002, 2006); Ledoit-Wolf degenerate, acceptable for reporting

aggregate_v0_3.definition: T1 harness diagnostics/calibration_2030/t1_aggregate.py at b27dce4: ArmFilter arm SH, build_rows weights_mode=rolling (consensus_weights_at(polls, T, 365) daily)
aggregate_v0_3.file_form: production timeseries schema via write_timeseries, 2-decimal rounding; SHA-256 recorded per run

body_hash_scope: bytes strictly before the last '<!-- FREEZE-BLOCK-START -->' marker
decided_by: user (plan approval 2026-11-18); open items resolved by the lead

fallback.FB_fails: production stays 1.2.0-rc1; only F1 may be proposed, on correctness grounds
fallback.coincidence: if T2 selects D0 and T3-rev selects N0, CAND equals FB: run once, record the result for both

global_rules.one_round_budget: last retrospective design round on 2010-2026 data for the 2030 model; afterwards a 2030-cycle model change may be justified only by T5 prospective evidence under a new preregistration that cites it

lead_edits_after_resolution: T2 Omega centres on a daily grid so the >=30 minimum does not set the first scored origin (lead, 2026-11-18)
2010 substitute rows (v0.2 and v0.3) use daily rolling weights from 2007-01-01 (lead, 2026-11-18)
order: build CAND and candidate path with C0 self-check
release proposal on a pass through its own amendment
